skill.description: 当用户需要做抖音账号诊断、抖音账号分析、抖音账号复盘、账号体检、播放低或不推流排查、近期作品表现整理和内容优化方向判断时使用。基于用户提供的抖音主页链接、分享文案或 sec_user_id，整理账号资料和近 30 天作品结果，输出可执行的账号分析报告。
skill.summary: Prepare evidence-based Douyin account reports from public profile data and recent posts using SocialDataX.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: All 47 static alerts are false positives involving Markdown, documented API setup, platform account identifiers, or readable Chinese text. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, or encoded payloads in the supplied files. remediation.issue: CLI examples automatically execute the mutable socialdatax-skills@latest package with access to the runtime environment.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and lock dependencies. Require approval before installation, verify package provenance, and limit runtime credentials and filesystem access.

content.user_title: Analyze Douyin Accounts With Evidence-Based Reports
content.value_statement: Public account data can be difficult to turn into clear content decisions. This skill guides SocialDataX queries and organizes recent posts into actionable reports.
actual_capabilities: Guide profile and post queries from a Douyin homepage, share text, or sec_user_id using an external CLI or configured MCP tools.
Define a default sample of up to 50 posts from the past 30 days, with adjustable dates and item limits.
Organize returned profile facts and post-level engagement into a structured account report.
Compare stronger and weaker sampled posts using visible topics, titles, publication times, formats, and public interactions.
Group posts into content themes, review publishing cadence, and propose three to five actions for a 30-day test plan.
Guide pagination and partial-result recovery while preserving retrieved items and reporting incomplete coverage.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key and available service balance; CLI use also requires Node.js, npm, and network access.
The supplied skill contains instructions, not the external CLI implementation; that package requires separate trust and review.
Cannot establish reach, completion rate, recommendation exposure, or distribution restrictions when those metrics are absent.
Analysis covers returned public samples only; account operations and guaranteed follower growth are outside its documented scope.

use_cases.title: Review Recent Creator Performance
use_cases.description: Compare recent posts, identify stronger content themes, and choose small experiments for the next month.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Brand Content Review
use_cases.description: Organize profile facts, public interactions, content categories, and publishing cadence for an operational review.

use_cases.title: Deliver an Evidence-Based Client Diagnosis
use_cases.description: Build a client report that separates observed facts, tentative explanations, missing metrics, and recommended tests.

prompt_templates.title: Start With a Small Account Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this Douyin homepage: [profile link]. Start with 10 recent posts and summarize profile facts, visible interactions, and missing data.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Recent Post Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [profile link] over the past 30 days, using at most 50 posts. Compare stronger and weaker posts using returned public interactions.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a Low-Reach Concern
prompt_templates.prompt: For [sec_user_id], assess weak performance from recent posts. Separate evidence from hypotheses. Do not infer distribution restrictions without relevant metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Recover a Partial Review and Plan Tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue the partial review for [sec_user_id] using the original filters and returned token. Respect remaining limits and propose a 30-day test plan.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: incomplete data and operational planning

output_examples.input: Illustrative supplied sample: six tutorials and four promotions. Tutorials receive more saves; impressions and completion metrics are absent.
output: Coverage: Ten supplied posts; this sample does not establish account-wide performance.
Observed pattern: Tutorials receive more saves than promotions in this sample.
Unavailable metrics: Impressions and completion rate were not provided.
Test plan: Maintain a recurring tutorial series for 30 days and compare saves and comments with the current sample.

output_examples.input: Illustrative supplied result: Twenty posts were collected before a temporary API error. A continuation token is available; the original limit was 50.
output: Status: Incomplete collection; retain the twenty retrieved posts and the error details.
Recovery: After resolving the error, continue with the unchanged token and original filters.
Remaining limit: Collect at most thirty additional posts while respecting the original page limit.
Reporting boundary: Label conclusions as provisional until collection finishes or a configured limit is reached.

best_practices: Use a reviewed, pinned CLI version and configure credentials privately through the documented environment variable.
Start with a bounded sample, confirm the account identity, and record the date window and coverage.
Separate facts from hypotheses, label missing metrics, and preserve continuation tokens when recovering partial results.
anti_patterns: Treating public engagement counts as proof of suppressed reach, completion rate, or recommendation-system behavior.
Inventing missing metrics or presenting a limited sample as complete platform coverage.
Restarting partial collections from the first page or repeatedly retrying insufficient-balance errors.

faq.question: Which account inputs can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a Douyin homepage, profile share text, or sec_user_id. A configured MCP tool can also resolve a public douyin_id.

faq.question: What setup does the skill require?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and sufficient service balance. Use a reviewed external CLI with Node.js and npm, or already configured MCP tools.

faq.question: How many posts does a normal review use?
faq.answer: The recommended starting sample is up to 50 posts from the past 30 days. A trial review can use 10 posts.

faq.question: Can it prove that Douyin has restricted distribution?
faq.answer: No. Without reach, exposure, or completion metrics, it can only describe public interactions and suggest evidence-based hypotheses.

faq.question: Does it log in or change my account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only and excludes login, posting, likes, comments, and account changes. The external package implementation was not supplied.

faq.question: What happens when collection stops partway?
faq.answer: Retain retrieved items, mark the report incomplete, resolve the error, and resume with the unchanged continuation token and remaining collection limits.
